steps.npc: It can't be that hard can it?
I guess this will be my last day of blood tithes, one way or another.
I will survive the Theatre! Just like Serafina did!
Soon I will be free!
I'm starting to think I made a mistake coming here.
Can't talk. I need to prepare myself.
What? What's wrong?

steps.player: Nothing, I just need to ask a couple of questions.

steps.npc: Oh, hello. How's everything?

steps.player: Not too bad thanks, but I wanted to ask a question.

steps.npc: Hello?

steps.player: Hello, I wonder if I could ask some questions.

steps.npc: Hey, don't sneak up on me like that!

steps.player: Sorry, didn't mean to scare you. I just wanted to ask a question.

steps.npc: Well, I guess so.

steps.player: What do you do here?

steps.npc: I'm barely surviving...
When I'm not being drained of blood, the vyrewatch force me to repair the walls.
When I'm not being drained of blood I'm fixing up the ghetto.
I just try to make a living the best way I can. You haven't got some food have you?
Like everyone else, I just survive here. Just try to keep alive till after the next blood tithe. That's when they feed us.
Why do you wanna know?

steps.player: Just curious, that's all.

steps.npc: I dunno. I don't know if I can trust you...

options.text: I'm lost... Can you help me?

steps.player: I'm lost... Can you help me?

steps.npc: Well, you're in sector [one/two/three/four/five/six], but if you were hoping for any other help then I'm very sorry. I find it hard enough to help myself.
Life's so very hard here. Before too long they'll be wanting to have another blood tithing and then I'll feel just awful again.

steps.player: What's a blood tithing?

steps.npc: You must be new here, else you'd know for sure. It's where we have to give a blood tithe to the vampyres. They do it on a weekly basis, a different sector each week so they don't kill us all off.

options.text: Do you know about the Myreque?

steps.player: Do you know about the Myreque?

steps.text: Before completing Sins of the Father:

steps.npc: It's probably best not to talk about that, friend.

steps.player: I need to make contact with them. Please don't worry - I'm on their side.

steps.npc: As are we all, but I really can't talk about them. It's not a subject easily broached here.

steps.text: After completing Sins of the Father:

steps.npc: The Myreque are gone. Do not speak of them, it will do you no good.

options.text: Can you tell me about the Sanguinesti region?

steps.player: Can you tell me about the Sanguinesti region?

steps.npc: Yep, that's where we are at the moment. This place, Meiyerditch, is just one large ghetto.
The city is sectioned off so that the vampyres can collect blood tithes on a rotational basis. That way they don't kill us all off in one go.

options.text: What do you know about the vampyres?

steps.player: What do you know about the vampyres?

steps.npc: They're monsters, I know that much. I've never known anything else, but I have a feeling it might be nice to not have to live in fear the whole time. Worrying if I'm going to make the next blood tithe quota.
I know that the juveniles are the lowest form of the vampyres. Apparently they were human once, converted by the vampyres.
Then you have juvinates. They're initiated juveniles who've had some training and are starting to get some powers.
After that you have the vyres. They're nasty... really nasty.

options.text: What do you know about Drakan?

steps.player: What do you know about Drakan?

steps.text: Before completing A Taste of Hope:

steps.npc: Drakan? Which one: Ranis or Vanescula?

steps.player: Well, I was referring to the main Drakan, you know, the overlord of Morytania.

steps.npc: Hmm, nothing has been seen of him for many years now. Some people say they occasionally see Ranis or Vanescula flying about, but it's not too often.

steps.text: After completing A Taste of Hope:

steps.npc: Vanescula?

steps.player: Well, I was referring to the main Drakan, you know, the overlord of Morytania.

steps.npc: Hmm, nothing has been seen of him for many years now. Some people say they occasionally see Vanescula flying about, but it's not too often.

steps.text: After completing Sins of the Father:

steps.npc: No one had seen anything of him for years, they say he's back now though. We shouldn't talk of him any more though, the vyrewatch might not like it.

options.text: What is there to do around here?

steps.player: What is there to do around here?

steps.npc: To do? Around here? Survive! Eke out an existence and just live for another day, that's it really.

The juvinates organise work crews to mine the daeyalt, fix the walls, the castles and so on. If we refuse to do the work, they put us on double tithes and you can't do that for long before you dry up.
If you want to escape, there's only one way. Anyone who survives in the theatre gets to leave. It's pointless though. No one survives.

options.text: Is there anything I can do to help?

steps.player: Is there anything I can do to help?

steps.npc: It's very nice of you to offer, my friend, but I shouldn't expect that you could do anything. The vampyres are just too powerful to overcome.
They say this place once had a Saradominist Queen. Even she could not withstand the vampyres. Anyone who has challenged their power in the past has come undone.

steps.player: Okay, thanks.
What do you do here?

steps.npc: I've been working on getting some things fixed up around here. Hopefully we can eventually make a proper home out of this city.
Just trying to make a living really. Things are a lot better now the vampyres aren't taking our blood, but it's still going to be a long time before we get this place in a good state.

steps.player: How are things here?

steps.npc: Well, the vampyres aren't taking our blood anymore, and they've promised to help us rebuild the city. Still, it's going to take a long time to fix this place up. Most people have chosen to leave instead.

steps.player: I'd best be off.

steps.npc: I often thought about trying out the Theatre myself before Drakan was dealt with. Glad I never ended up doing that!
It's nice that they let us watch the performances in the Theatre now. It's fun seeing how good some of those warriors from Misthalin are!
Going to give the Theatre a go? You look like you've got what it takes.

if-the-player-improperly-accesses-meiyer.npc: What're you doin' in here? You don't belong here! Go back to where you came from, 'fore the vyrewatch sees ya.

if-the-player-is-wearing-vyre-noble-clot.npc: Oh... Sorry, we're not meant to talk to the nobles.
